environment.description: Application deployed on a GCE instance running in project 'corp-staging'. The Flask app is exposed directly via an external TCP load balancer (L4) on port 443 with TLS termination only. No additional middleware or proxy-level filtering is configured. The instance runs Ubuntu 22.04 with Python 3.10 and the app is managed by systemd. Network firewall allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database file is on a persistent disk mounted at /var/lib/app/.

config.load_balancer: GCP Network TCP Load Balancer (L4, passthrough)
